paragraphs.text: Mist is an obsolete creature type for cards that represented elemental mist.
Mist debuted as a creature type in Homelands on Hungry Mist . With the release of Masters Edition on Magic Online the type was obsoleted and given errata to just be Elemental .

On Dominaria , Hungry Mist appears to be an elemental entity comprised of a green gaseous substance. It appears to be able to shift its form into any shape, including claws, a face, or tentacles. Dominaria also features various other mist creatures including the illusionary Krovikan Mist that can trap creatures who believe in its strength, various Mistform creatures including the sapient Mistform Ultimus , and the Mistfolk .
Older vampires on Innistrad can transform into a similar elemental form of Insidious Mist .
